title: Melee Artist
summary: Melee Artist is the pink-haired Titan of Billie, one of the three Huntik Foundation operatives working in the museum of Nostradamus' tower. This Titan has four arms, each equipped with a golden sword.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Melee Artist was summoned to defend the tower of Nostradamus from [[Wilder]]'s team of [[the Organization|Organization]] members seeking out a scrying glass artifact. Although Melee Artist appeared to be a powerful Titan, it was defeated by [[Hoffman|Hoffman's]] [[Touchram]] spell while taking a blow for Billie. {{Source|The Tower of Nostradamus}}

Melee Artist and Billie later guarded [[Clements]] as he performed research via two [[Holotome]]s. Melee Artist fought one on one with a [[Marauder]] and defeated the assailant with help from [[Guggenheim]]. {{Source|Lok and the Betrayer}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Melee Artist's known abilities appear to come from its physical strength. Melee Artist is quick, strong and, with it's four arms and four golden swords, would be a force to be reckoned with. Of note, his swords bear resemblance to those of [[Sabriel]].
